title: Build and Optimize a Docker Image
description: Build a Python app image and optimize it with multi-stage builds.
scenario:
## Scenario

You have a Python FastAPI app. The initial naive Dockerfile produces a 1.2GB image. The optimized Dockerfile is `Dockerfile.multistage`, and the optimized build should be easy to compare under the `myapp:optimized` tag.

Your task:
1. Examine the current image size
2. Build with the optimized multi-stage Dockerfile
3. Verify the final image is under 200MB
objectives: ["Check the current image size","Build with the optimized Dockerfile","Inspect the final image layers"]
validCommands:
[{"command":"docker images myapp","response":"REPOSITORY   TAG       IMAGE ID       CREATED         SIZE
myapp        latest    a3b4c5d6e7f8   2 minutes ago   1.24GB"},{"command":"docker build -t myapp:optimized -f Dockerfile.multistage .","response":"[+] Building 45.2s (12/12) FINISHED
Successfully tagged myapp:optimized"},{"command":"docker images myapp:optimized","response":"REPOSITORY   TAG         IMAGE ID       CREATED          SIZE
myapp        optimized   f9e8d7c6b5a4   10 seconds ago   142MB","completes":true}]
ambientCommands:
[{"command":"docker version","response":"Client: Docker Engine - Community
 Version:           24.0.7
Server: Docker Engine - Community
 Version:           24.0.7"},{"command":"docker ps","response":"CONTAINER ID   IMAGE     COMMAND   CREATED   STATUS    PORTS     NAMES"},{"command":"docker network ls","response":"NETWORK ID     NAME      DRIVER    SCOPE
a1b2c3d4e5f6   bridge    bridge    local
7g8h9i0j1k2l   host      host      local"},{"command":"ls","response":"Dockerfile  Dockerfile.multistage  requirements.txt  app.py  src"},{"command":"cat Dockerfile","response":"FROM python:3.12
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["python", "app.py"]"},{"command":"cat Dockerfile.multistage","response":"FROM python:3.12 AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt ./

COPY --from=build /install /usr/local
COPY --from=build /app /app
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["python", "app.py"]"},{"command":"docker images","response":"REPOSITORY   TAG       IMAGE ID       CREATED         SIZE
myapp        latest    a3b4c5d6e7f8   2 minutes ago   1.24GB
python       3.12      f1e2d3c4b5a6   3 days ago      1.01GB"}]
